board_info.description: CPU-controlled sound board with 6802/6808 processor, TMS5200 speech synthesizer, and AY-3-8912 programmable sound generator
board_info.documentation_notes: Complete diagnostic-level documentation covering all connectors, power systems, digital buses, and audio signal paths from sources to speaker output

J1.description: AC power input and sound select signals from MPU

1.signal_path: Via R67 (10K), U16-4049 buffer, and EE switch

2.signal_path: Via R66 (10K), U16-4049 buffer, and EE switch

3.signal_path: Via R65 (10K), U16-4049 buffer, and EE switch

4.signal_path: Via R64 (10K), U16-4049 buffer, and EE switch

5.signal_path: Via R63 (10K), U16-4049 buffer, and EE switch
5.note: This is physically J1-12, part of sound select group

6.destination: System ground - connects to J1-14 and power supply ground network

7.signal_path: Via C37 (330µF) to voltage doubler with CR7, CR8, completing with J1-15, J1-16, J1-18
7.note: Part of voltage doubler that generates negative voltage rail for -5V regulator

8.signal_path: Via R10 (10K), C9 (470pF) to ground for filtering, U16-4049 buffer, and EE switch

10.signal_path: Connects with J1-17, through CR2 rectifier and C14 (4700µF) filtering

12.function: Sound select input bit 4 (see pin 5 notes)
12.note: This pin is actually described under J1-5 tracing above

14.destination: System ground and +5V regulator (VR1) input network
14.signal_path: Connects with J1-6, feeds through filtering network (C49, C50, C15, C16) to VR1 LM323 regulator with heatsink, outputs to TP2 (+5V) and TP1 (GND)

15.signal_path: Connects with J1-16, through voltage doubler network (CR7, CR8, C38), feeds VR2 LM320ML/-5V regulator with filtering (C47, C48, C22), outputs to TP4 (-5V)

notes.sound_select_group: J1-1, J1-2, J1-3, J1-4, J1-12 are collectively labeled 'Sound Select'
notes.ee_switches: All sound select signals pass through U16-4049 buffers and EE switches before reaching U12 (AY-3-8912) IO pins or U11 (PIA2)
notes.voltage_doubler: J1-7, J1-15, J1-16, J1-18 form voltage doubler circuit with CR7, CR8, C37, C38

J2.description: Audio output connector - speaker output, volume control inputs, and returns

2.signal_path: From U16 TDA2002 power amplifier via C27 (1000µfd) and R35 (1Ω)
2.note: Final mixed output of speech and sound channels

5.signal_path: Through CR10 (1N4004), R69 (1K), R70 (1K), C40 (0.1µF), C41 (0.1µF) network
5.note: External potentiometer voltage input for speech volume control

6.signal_path: Through R57 (1K), R58 (1K), C40 (0.1µF), C41 (0.1µF) network
6.note: External potentiometer voltage input for sound (tones) volume control

notes.volume_controls: Two independent volume controls - speech (J2-5/TP5) and sound (J2-6/TP6)
notes.audio_architecture: Mixed output from two channels: TMS5200 speech and combined AY-3-8912/DAC tones

J3.description: Data bus, Address bus, and Vocalizer bus connection to MPU

1.destination: System ground - connects directly to J3-2

2.destination: System ground - connects directly to J3-1

6.note: Mostly direct fan-out. TP8 monitors raw E signal. U15 LS14 also processes E for other uses.

7.destination: Self-test LED circuit via R6 (470Ω) → LED → Q1 → R7 (8.2K) → U11-39 (PIA2 CA2)

signal_conditioning.critical_node: N4 - distribution point after first inversion with R1 (27k pullup to +5V) and C1 (27µF to ground) for conditioning
signal_conditioning.stage_2: N4 → U15-1 (second LS14 stage) → U15-2 output → ADDRESS BUS destinations
signal_conditioning.note: Two-stage inversion/conditioning with timing network at N4

11.destination: Pullup labeled 'Unreg return' - connects directly to J3-12

12.destination: Pullup labeled 'Unreg return' - connects directly to J3-11

13.source: U13 top LM3900 low-pass filter output (TMS5200 speech signal)
13.signal_path: U8 TMS5200 pin 8 → U13 top filter → R81 (0.1K), C24 (1µfd) → splits to J3-13 and to R12 (1K) → U14 top VCA
13.note: External monitoring point for filtered speech audio before VCA - signal continues to VCA regardless

destinations: LS14 pin 11 input → LS14 pin 10 output (VMĀ) → U7-2 (PIA1 1Ḡ) and U17-14 (LS155 2Ḡ)
14.note: Inverted to VMĀ via LS14 to enable PIA and address decoder

15.function: Vocalizer Control Bus - PIA Port B bit 3

16.function: Vocalizer Control Bus - PIA Port B bit 2

destinations: Conditional routing to ROM pins 21 and 18 via chip select logic
17.rom_routing: Complex - see address_decode section for chip select logic

18.note: U1-21 is VSS (ground), not address pin

destinations: Address decode logic - not yet fully traced
U17-1 (LS155 decoder pin 1C - conditional via chip select 'H')

26.note: Part of system data bus, also feeds DAC through resistor bank

40.note: Note: U8 (TMS5200) has a separate 'D0' label on pin 14 connected to U7-9 (PIA1 PA7) - this is the speech chip's own data interface, not system data bus. Similarly U12 (AY-3-8912) has 'D0' on pin 28 connected to U11-2 (PIA2 PA0) through EE switch.

notes.data_bus_protection: D0-D7 have 10K series resistors (R71-R78) feeding AD558 DAC for current limiting
notes.peripheral_interfaces: TMS5200 and AY-3-8912 have separate data interfaces through PIA port pins, not directly on system data bus
notes.control_signals: R/W̄, E, RESET̄, VMA, MEM ENBL all documented with signal conditioning where applicable
notes.vocalizer_control: Pins 15-16 (PB2, PB3) connect to PIA2 for Vocalizer Control Bus

address_decode.description: Complex address decoding for ROM chip selects and memory banking using 74LS155 dual 2-to-4 decoder

U17_LS155_decoder.function: Dual 2-to-4 line decoder for generating ROM chip selects

decoder_1.1C: Pin 1 - Gets A15 (labeled 'H') OR signal from LS14 processing MEM ENBL/J3-9 (labeled 'J')
decoder_1.1Ḡ: Pin 2 - Strobe from VMA (Valid Memory Address) signal - also loops to pin 14

decoder_2.2Ḡ: Pin 14 - Shared strobe from VMA via pin 2

inputs.note: Both decoder sections share the same VMA strobe signal via pins 2→14 feedback

ROM_chip_select_logic.description: ROMs U2-U5 have conditional chip select routing based on address decoding

diagnostic_significance.purpose: This complex decode allows memory banking - same physical ROM can appear at different address ranges
diagnostic_significance.chip_select_letters: Letters D, F, G, P, Q, R, S, T, U, V, W, X, Y, Z, AA, BB are decoded chip select signals from U17 LS155 outputs
diagnostic_significance.troubleshooting: If ROMs not responding, check: (1) VMA signal active, (2) U17 decoder receiving correct address lines, (3) Chip select signals reaching ROM pins, (4) A11 routing switches working correctly

pending_signals.VMA: Valid Memory Address signal - source not yet traced, feeds U17-2 which loops to U17-14
pending_signals.MEM_ENBL: Memory Enable signal from J3-9 - processed through LS14 before reaching U17-1 as 'J' chip select
pending_signals.A14_usage: A14 (J3-22) destination in decode logic not yet fully traced

audio_system.description: Dual-channel audio architecture with independent volume controls for speech and sound

architecture_overview.speech_channel: TMS5200 speech synthesis → Low-pass filter → VCA (Speech Volume control) → Power amplifier
architecture_overview.sound_channel: AY-3-8912 tones + CPU DAC tones → Low-pass filter (AY only) → VCA (Sound Volume control) → Power amplifier
architecture_overview.final_stage: Both channels mixed at U16 TDA2002 power amplifier → J2-2 speaker output (4Ω)

speech_audio_path.description: TMS5200 speech synthesis audio path with low-pass filtering and volume control

signal_flow.signal: Analog speech output from TMS5200 speech synthesizer

signal_flow.note: Both paths active simultaneously - J3-13 is monitoring point, not loop

signal_flow.control: TP5 Speech Volume Control Voltage from J2-5

test_points: J3-13 ANALOG: Monitoring point after filter, before VCA
U14-4: VCA output before power amp

sound_audio_path.description: Dual-source tone generation (AY-3-8912 + CPU DAC) with shared volume control

source_A.path: TP7 (AY3-8912 OUTPUT test point) → continues to low-pass filter

source_B.control: U10-9 (CĒ) enabled by U15-8 (LS14) from TP8 (E clock) via U12-15
source_B.data_input: D0-D7 system data bus via resistor bank R71-R78 (10K each)
source_B.path: R79 (7.5K) → node with R80 (2K to ground) → C43 (2µF) → R54 (82K) → CR6 → bypasses filter, goes directly to VCA input

signal_flow.note: AY-3-8912 tones pass through low-pass filter; DAC tones have direct path to VCA

signal_flow.applies_to: U12 AY-3-8912 output only - U10 DAC bypasses this filter

signal_flow.description: AY-3-8912 (filtered) and U10 DAC (unfiltered) signals merge

signal_flow.control: TP6 Sound Volume Control Voltage from J2-6

signal_flow.path: R42 (10K) → C34 (1.0µfd) → U16-1 (power amp input, mixes with speech)

test_points: U14 bottom output: Mixed tone VCA output before power amp

final_power_stage.description: TDA2002 power amplifier mixes both channels and drives speaker

inputs.speech_channel: Via R19 (10K) and C25 (1.0µfd) from U14 top VCA
inputs.sound_channel: Via R42 (10K) and C34 (1.0µfd) from U14 bottom VCA
inputs.mixing: Both signals converge at U16-1 input pin

power.power_rail: From J1-10/J1-17 +12V unreg through rectification and filtering

output.path: U16-4 output → C27 (1000µfd coupling) → R35 (1Ω current sense) → J2-2

volume_control_system.description: Two independent voltage-controlled amplifiers with external potentiometer inputs

speech_volume_control.function: External potentiometer provides DC control voltage (0-5V range) to modulate speech audio level

sound_volume_control.function: External potentiometer provides DC control voltage (0-5V range) to modulate tone audio level

vca_operation.principle: LM3900 Norton amplifier configured as voltage-controlled attenuator
vca_operation.control_mechanism: Control voltage modulates diode bias (CR9/CR11 for speech, CR5/CR6 for tones)
vca_operation.range: Essentially full muting to full volume based on 0-5V control input

check_sequence: 1. Verify power: +5V (TP2), +11.5V (TP3), -5V (TP4)
2. Check U16 power amp: +11.5V on power pin, heatsink not excessively hot
3. Verify signal at U16-1 input (should show activity during operation)
4. Check J2-2 speaker connection and speaker integrity (4Ω)
5. Verify C27 (1000µfd) coupling capacitor not shorted or open

speech_works_no_tones.likely_cause: Tone generation or tone VCA failure
check_sequence: 1. Check TP7 for AY-3-8912 output activity
2. Check U10 DAC output at pin 16
3. Verify TP6 sound volume control voltage present (0-5V)
4. Check U14 bottom VCA output
5. Trace R42/C34 path to U16 for opens
1. Check U8 TMS5200 pin 8 for speech output activity
2. Monitor J3-13 ANALOG for filtered speech signal
3. Verify TP5 speech volume control voltage present (0-5V)
4. Check U13 top filter operation
5. Check U14 top VCA output
6. Trace R19/C25 path to U16 for opens
1. Verify volume control voltages at TP5 and TP6 (should vary 0-5V)
2. Check VCA bias components (R17, R18, R20, R68 for speech; R32, R36, R37 for tones)
3. Check coupling capacitors (C25, C34, C27) for leakage or value drift
4. Verify U16 power amp feedback network (R34, C29)
5. Check speaker impedance (should be 4Ω)
1. Check all power supply rails for ripple or noise
2. Verify filter capacitors (C20, C21 for speech; C32 for tones)
3. Check op-amp bias resistors (R27 for speech filter, R51 for tone filter)
4. Look for damaged diodes (CR9, CR11, CR5, CR6)
5. Check ground connections throughout audio path

U1.function: Main processor controlling sound board operations

U8.function: Linear predictive coding speech synthesis chip

8.destination: U13-11 (top low-pass filter input) → audio path to speaker
8.note: Analog speech output - primary audio source for speech channel

U8.audio_output: Pin 8 generates analog speech waveform that feeds into low-pass filtering and VCA stages
U8.diagnostic_notes: Check pin 8 for audio activity during speech playback - should show varying analog voltage

U10.function: Digital-to-Analog Converter for CPU-controlled tone generation

1-8.source: System data bus via R77-R71 (10K resistor bank)

9.source: U15-8 (LS14 output) ← U15-9 ← TP8 (E clock) ← U12-15

16.destination: R79 (7.5K) → tone audio path to U14 bottom VCA
16.note: Analog tone output - bypasses low-pass filter, goes directly to VCA

U10.audio_path: Pin 16 → R79 (7.5K) → R80 (2K to gnd) node → C43 (2µF) → R54 (82K) → CR6 → U14-1 (bottom VCA input)
U10.function_note: Provides CPU-controlled tone generation that mixes with AY-3-8912 hardware tones
U10.diagnostic_notes: Check pin 16 for analog output activity when CPU generates tones - should show varying voltage

18.source: J1-8 (Sound Interrupt) via U16-4049 and EE switch

U12.function: 3-channel tone/noise generator with I/O ports and envelope control

10.source: J1-12 via R63, U16-4049, and EE switch

11.source: J1-4 via R64, U16-4049, and EE switch

12.source: J1-3 via R65, U16-4049, and EE switch

13.source: J1-2 via R66, U16-4049, and EE switch

14.source: J1-1 via R67, U16-4049, and EE switch

A.destination: TP7 (AY3-8912 OUTPUT) → U13 bottom low-pass filter → U14 bottom VCA

U12.audio_output: Pin A generates mixed analog output of 3 tone channels plus noise - feeds through low-pass filter before VCA
U12.io_ports_note: IO0-IO4 connect to sound select inputs from MPU via EE switches - used for additional control beyond data bus
U12.diagnostic_notes: Check TP7 for tone output activity - should show varying analog voltage during tone generation

U13.function: Audio low-pass filtering - two sections for speech and tone audio paths

top_section.input: Pin 11 from U8 TMS5200 pin 8 (SPEECH OUT)
top_section.output: Pin 10 → R81 (0.1K), C24 (1µfd) → splits to J3-13 and U14 top VCA
top_section.cutoff_frequency: Removes high-frequency artifacts from TMS5200 speech synthesis

bottom_section.output: Merges with U10 DAC output before U14 bottom VCA input
bottom_section.note: U10 DAC bypasses this filter - only AY-3-8912 tones are filtered

U13.diagnostic_notes: Test at outputs (pins 10 and bottom output) to verify filtering - should see clean waveforms without excessive high-frequency content

U14.function: Dual voltage-controlled amplifiers (VCAs) for independent speech and sound volume control

top_section.input: Pin 2 from R28 (82K) ← CR9 ← filtered speech from U13
top_section.output: Pin 4 → R19 (10K), C25 (1.0µfd) → U16 power amp
top_section.volume_control: TP5 SPEECH VOLUME CONTROL VOLTAGE from J2-5
top_section.operation: Control voltage (0-5V) modulates diode bias to vary gain from mute to full volume

bottom_section.function: Tone audio VCA (both AY-3-8912 and DAC)
bottom_section.input: Pin 1 receives merged signals: AY-3-8912 (filtered via U13) + U10 DAC (direct via R54, CR6)
bottom_section.output: Bottom output → R42 (10K), C34 (1.0µfd) → U16 power amp
bottom_section.volume_control: TP6 SOUND VOLUME CONTROL VOLTAGE from J2-6
bottom_section.operation: Control voltage (0-5V) modulates gain for combined tone sources

U14.vca_principle: LM3900 Norton amplifier configured as voltage-controlled attenuator using diode bias modulation
U14.diagnostic_notes: Check control voltages at TP5 and TP6 (should vary 0-5V with pot adjustment). Test outputs for proper audio levels and clean amplification without clipping

U16.function: Sound select and interrupt signal buffering/inversion

1.note: Ground on component for sound interrupt path, +5V pullup on component for sound select paths

2.signal: Output to U11-18 via EE switch

4.signal: Output to U12-10 via EE switch

6.signal: Output to U12-11 via EE switch

10.signal: Output to U12-12 via EE switch

power_amplifier.function: Final power amplification stage - mixes speech and tone channels and drives 4Ω speaker
power_amplifier.note: Designated as U16 on schematic (conflicts with U16 4049 buffer - may be schematic labeling issue or separate sheet)

inputs.pin_1: Mixed audio input - receives speech channel (via R19, C25) and tone channel (via R42, C34)

output.pin_4: Amplified audio output → C27 (1000µfd) → R35 (1Ω) → J2-2 speaker

power_amplifier.diagnostic_notes: Check for proper +11.5V supply, verify heatsink not excessively hot, scope output for clean waveform without clipping. Common failures: shorted output (checks speaker), open C27 (no audio), damaged by over-current

diagnostic_notes.approach: This board has its own CPU, so diagnostics focus on: (1) Power supply integrity, (2) CPU operation and bus activity, (3) Sound select command reception, (4) Speech and tone generation functional testing, (5) Audio output path verification
critical_first_checks: TP8 (E clock) should show clock activity
TP12 (RESET̄) should be high during normal operation
